projectState.summary: Byte 8 is implemented and ready for Claude review. src/thought-protocol.ts defines phrase-relative MusicalExcerpt markup, PlayerThoughtRequest, PlayerThoughtIntent, validation helpers, formatting, and a deterministic mock responder. PlayerThoughtRequest wraps PlayerThoughtSeed and owns requestLevel/constraints; PlayerThinkingProfile.disposition is documented as prompt-facing identity while taste remains behavior-facing. The app exposes request/intent summaries in the Thoughts inspector and window.thinking.getRequests()/getMockIntents(). No Ollama, persistence, producer command, transport, taste, session, or audio behavior changes were intended.
